description: Send one signed test delivery to a webhook endpoint now and report how its receiver answered: { eventId, type, delivered, statusCode, latencyMs, error }. It waits up to 15 seconds for the receiver, and the call succeeds even when the receiver failed, so read delivered, statusCode and error (null when delivered; otherwise timeout, connection, tls, redirect, http_4xx, http_5xx, gone, blocked_address, payload_too_large, or internal, which is PostFast's own failure). Without sampleEvent it sends a webhook.test event, whose data is { webhook: { id, url }, message }. With sampleEvent it sends a fixed sample of that event type, built exactly like a real one so the receiver can be set up before any real event happens: ids of zeros, platform X, the post text "Sample post from PostFast" or the account @sample, and no real post or account data. A test counts like any delivery: it shows in list_webhook_deliveries, a failure adds to the endpoint's failure count, and a 410 Gone answer turns the endpoint off. webhook.disabled means PostFast has webhooks switched off for now, not that this endpoint is off.

sampleEvent.description: Send a fixed sample of this event type instead of webhook.test
